operations.description: Creates a subscription to notifications informing you of events on your platform. After the subscription is created, the events specified in the configuration will be sent to the URL specified in the configuration. Subscriptions must be configured on a per-event basis (as opposed to, for example, a per-account holder basis), so all event notifications of a marketplace and of a given type will be sent to the same endpoint(s). A marketplace may have multiple endpoints if desired; an event notification may be sent to as many or as few different endpoints as configured.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] create notification configuration [PATH] create notification configuration [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] configuration create details event notification request response

operations.description: Deletes an existing notification subscription configuration. After the subscription is deleted, no further event notifications will be sent to the URL defined in the subscription.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] delete notification configurations [PATH] delete notification configurations [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] configuration delete generic notification request response

operations.description: Returns the details of the configuration of a notification subscription.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] notification configuration [PATH] notification configuration [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] configuration details event notification request response

operations.description: Returns the details of the configurations of all of the notification subscriptions in the platform of the executing user.
operations.summary: Get a list of notification subscription configurations
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] notification configuration list [PATH] notification configuration list [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] configuration details empty event list notification request response

operations.description: Tests an existing notification subscription configuration. For each event type specified, a test notification will be generated and sent to the URL configured in the subscription specified.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] test notification configuration [PATH] test notification configuration [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] configuration exchange message notification request response test

operations.description: Updates an existing notification subscription configuration. If you are updating the event types, you must provide all event types, otherwise the previous event type configuration will be overwritten.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] update notification configuration [PATH] update notification configuration [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] configuration details event notification request response update
